description: This file contains unit tests for the CountersGrain implementation in an Orleans-based event sourcing project. It tests functionalities such as recording counter increments, concurrent increments, and state resets, using the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: CountersGrainTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the functionality of CountersGrain, including counter operations and concurrent updates.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Tests recording multiple increments, resetting counters, and verifying tentative state.

methods.name: ConcurrentIncrements
methods.description: Tests concurrent increment operations on the grain.

methods.name: RandomKey
methods.description: Returns a random key from predefined keys for use in concurrent increment tests.

methods.name: ConcurrentIncrementsRunner
methods.description: Performs concurrent increments and verifies tentative and confirmed states, then resets counters.
